content:
heap-use-after-free in `mark_context_stack` (`gc.c:659`) - callinfo stack realloc during incremental GC
### Summary

A `cipush` callinfo-stack reallocation that happens **during** an incremental-GC step leaves `mark_context_stack` reading a freed context stack - a heap-use-after-free. Reachable from plain Ruby source via `mrb_load_string`; ASAN-confirmed on current `master`.

### Version

```
master @ 7f035bb60 (2026-06-22)   # also confirmed at 01e1e2ba3
```
ASAN build (`-fsanitize=address`).

### Build configuration (to reproduce with ASAN)

`build_config/asan.rb`:

```ruby
MRuby::Build.new do |conf|
  conf.toolchain :clang
  conf.gembox 'default'
  conf.cc.flags      << %w(-fsanitize=address -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  conf.cxx.flags     << %w(-fsanitize=address -g -O1) if conf.respond_to?(:cxx)
  conf.linker.flags  << %w(-fsanitize=address)
end
```

```sh
git clone https://github.com/mruby/mruby && cd mruby
git submodule update --init --recursive          # pulls Prism (mrbgems/mruby-compiler/lib/prism)
# carry ASAN in CC *and* LD so host tools (mrbc/presym) also link the ASAN runtime:
CC="clang -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer" \
CXX="clang++ -fsanitize=address -g -O1" \
LD="clang -fsanitize=address" \
  rake MRUBY_CONFIG=$PWD/build_config/asan.rb
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 ./build/host/bin/mruby t.rb
```

### Reproducer

```ruby
(6..10).to_a.index{GC.malloc_threshold=4
def a =[]!=a
u=a}
```

```sh
$ ./bin/mruby t.rb
```

(The low `GC.malloc_threshold` forces frequent incremental GC so the race window is hit deterministically; the block body grows the callinfo stack via the nested call/`def`.)

### ASAN report

```
==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free ...
READ of size 8 at 0x51b000000668 thread T0
    #0 mark_context_stack   src/gc.c:659:17
    #1 mark_context         src/gc.c:688:3
    #2 root_scan_phase      src/gc.c:1095:3
    #3 incremental_gc       src/gc.c:1302:5
    #4 incremental_gc_step  src/gc.c:1346:15
    #5 mrb_incremental_gc   src/gc.c:1394:5
    #6 mrb_realloc_simple   src/gc.c:234:7      <-- realloc triggers the GC step
    #7 mrb_realloc          src/gc.c:246:8
    #8 cipush               src/vm.c:386:32     <-- ... while growing the callinfo stack
    #9 mrb_vm_exec          src/vm.c:2804:12
   #10 mrb_yield            src/vm.c:1353:10
   #11 mrb_ary_index_m      src/array.c:1601:22
```
comments https://api.github.com/repos/mruby/mruby/issues/6906/comments

COMMENT matz
Thanks again for another precise ASan report. There were actually two instances of the same bug: `cipush` (growing the callinfo stack) and `stack_extend_alloc` (growing the VM value stack) both call `mrb_realloc`, which can run an incremental GC step after freeing the old buffer but before the context pointers are reassigned, so the collector marked the freed stack. Fixed on master (0bfdb9c18) by disabling GC across each realloc. Your reproducer now raises a clean `SystemStackError` instead of corrupting memory. Thanks!
